"""Load both labeled CSV roots into the local DuckDB output port."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import dlt
from dlt.sources.filesystem import filesystem, read_csv

from nxd import data_product
from nxd.core.context import DuckDbOutput


BASE_MODELS = ("orders", "users")
DERIVED_MODELS = ()
PHYSICAL_MODELS = BASE_MODELS + DERIVED_MODELS


def _labeled_root(transform_root: Path, path_file: str) -> Path:
    """Resolve a connector path file strictly below the pinned root."""
    relative = (transform_root / path_file).read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    candidate = Path(relative)
    if not relative or candidate.is_absolute() or ".." in candidate.parts:
        raise RuntimeError(f"connector path must be relative and contained: {relative!r}")
    return transform_root / candidate


@data_product.on_transform()
def ingest(duckdb: DuckDbOutput, secrets: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Read both labeled roots from the immutable supervisor execution root."""
    del secrets  # Labeled CSV roots are carried by path files, not secret keys.
    transform_root = Path(os.environ["NXD_TRANSFORM_ROOT"])
    orders_root = _labeled_root(transform_root, "csv-source-orders-path")
    users_root = _labeled_root(transform_root, "csv-source-users-path")

    run_dir = Path(duckdb.path).parent
    pipelines_dir = run_dir / "dlt-pipelines"
    pipelines_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    os.environ["DLT_DATA_DIR"] = str(run_dir / "dlt-data")

    pipeline = dlt.pipeline(
        pipelines_dir=str(pipelines_dir),
        destination=dlt.destinations.duckdb(credentials=duckdb.path),
        dataset_name=duckdb.schema,
    )
    resources = [
        (
            filesystem(bucket_url=str(orders_root / "orders"), file_glob="*.csv")
            | read_csv()
        ).with_name(duckdb.model_tables["orders"]),
        (
            filesystem(bucket_url=str(users_root / "users"), file_glob="*.csv")
            | read_csv()
        ).with_name(duckdb.model_tables["users"]),
    ]
    pipeline.run(resources, write_disposition="replace")

    actual = set(pipeline.default_schema.data_table_names())
    expected = {duckdb.model_tables[model] for model in PHYSICAL_MODELS}
    if actual != expected:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"dlt produced tables {sorted(actual)!r}, expected {sorted(expected)!r}"
        )
    (run_dir / ".transform-complete").touch()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    data_product.main()

"""Load both labeled CSV roots into the local DuckDB output port."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import dlt
from dlt.sources.filesystem import filesystem, read_csv

from nxd import data_product
from nxd.core.context import DuckDbOutput


BASE_MODELS = ("orders", "users")
DERIVED_MODELS = ()
PHYSICAL_MODELS = BASE_MODELS + DERIVED_MODELS
OPTIONAL_EMPTY_MODELS = ()


def _pinned_root() -> Path:
    """Return the immutable supervisor snapshot root; fail closed if absent."""
    return Path(os.environ["NXD_TRANSFORM_ROOT"])


def _source_root(snapshot_root: Path, label: str) -> Path:
    path_file = snapshot_root / f"csv-source-{label}-path"
    relative_root = path_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    if not relative_root or Path(relative_root).is_absolute():
        raise RuntimeError(f"invalid relative source path for {label!r}")
    root = snapshot_root / relative_root
    if not root.is_dir():
        raise FileNotFoundError(root)
    return root


@data_product.on_transform()
def ingest(duckdb: DuckDbOutput, secrets: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Land each labeled source model without changing source records."""
    del secrets  # Labeled CSV roots are delivered by path companions.
    snapshot_root = _pinned_root()
    source_roots = {
        "orders": _source_root(snapshot_root, "orders"),
        "users": _source_root(snapshot_root, "users"),
    }

    run_dir = Path(duckdb.path).parent
    pipelines_dir = run_dir / "dlt-pipelines"
    pipelines_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    os.environ["DLT_DATA_DIR"] = str(run_dir / "dlt-data")

    pipeline = dlt.pipeline(
        pipelines_dir=str(pipelines_dir),
        destination=dlt.destinations.duckdb(credentials=duckdb.path),
        dataset_name=duckdb.schema,
    )
    resources = []
    for label in BASE_MODELS:
        reader = filesystem(
            bucket_url=str(source_roots[label] / label), file_glob="*.csv"
        ) | read_csv()
        resources.append(reader.with_name(duckdb.model_tables[label]))

    pipeline.run(resources, write_disposition="replace")

    actual = set(pipeline.default_schema.data_table_names())
    expected = {duckdb.model_tables[model] for model in PHYSICAL_MODELS}
    optional = {duckdb.model_tables[model] for model in OPTIONAL_EMPTY_MODELS}
    missing = expected - actual
    absent_optional = missing & optional
    if actual != expected - absent_optional:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"dlt produced tables {sorted(actual)!r}, expected required tables "
            f"{sorted(expected - optional)!r}; optional absent tables "
            f"{sorted(absent_optional)!r}; unexpected tables "
            f"{sorted(actual - expected)!r}"
        )
    (run_dir / ".transform-complete").touch()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    data_product.main()
